capabilities: Browse a local folder as a file tree with git status
View files with syntax highlighting, find in file and go to line
Review git diffs grouped by conflicts, staged and unstaged, unified or side-by-side
Search files with git grep and view file history and blame
Copy links, embeds or code blocks of selected lines into notes
disambiguation: Not a git client: it only runs read-only git commands and never writes to the repository.
extras: Requires desktop Obsidian 1.7.2+; git features need git on the PATH. Makes no network requests and only runs read-only git commands, so it never writes to the repository. Links and embeds use absolute paths, so they only work on the computer that made them.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to read code from outside the vault or review a repository's changes without switching to an editor or git client.
summary: Read-only code browser that opens any local folder with syntax highlighting, git diffs, blame, search, and code links or embeds in notes.
